meta.title: Daggerheart Supplemental Content
meta.description: Additional ancestries, communities, and game data not found in the core rulebook PDF but used by the app.

chunks.text:
COMMUNITY: DUNEBORNE
Being part of a duneborne community means you come from an arid, desert climate and have adapted to harsh, shifting landscapes. Duneborne communities thrive in the vast deserts and sun-scorched plains, building resilient societies around oases, trade routes, and ancient ruins half-buried in sand. Members of these communities are known for their resourcefulness, endurance, and deep knowledge of survival in extreme heat. Duneborne are often traders, nomadic herders, or guardians of forgotten places.
Community Feature - Oasis: During a short rest, you or an ally can reroll a die used for a downtime action. This represents the duneborne ability to find moments of respite and renewal even in the harshest conditions.

COMMUNITY: FREEBORNE
Being part of a freeborne community means you come from a society that was once under tyrannical rule but is now liberated. Freeborne communities carry the scars and pride of their struggle for independence. Their cultures emphasize freedom, self-determination, and vigilance against oppression. Members are often fiercely independent, deeply loyal to their people, and wary of authority. Freeborne communities celebrate their liberation through art, storytelling, and communal gatherings that honor those who fought for their freedom.
Community Feature - Unbound: Once per session, when you roll with Fear, you can change it to a roll with Hope instead. This reflects the freeborne spirit of turning fear and oppression into defiant courage.

COMMUNITY: FROSTBORNE
Being part of a frostborne community means you are hardy folk from frozen tundras or high-altitude glacial regions. Frostborne communities endure some of the most brutal climates in the world, building their lives around survival, communal warmth, and respect for the land. They are known for their resilience, patience, and deep bonds with one another — qualities forged by long winters and shared hardship. Frostborne communities often have rich oral traditions passed down during the long dark months.
Community Feature - Hardy: Once per rest, you can Help an Ally traverse difficult terrain without spending a Hope. This represents the frostborne expertise in navigating harsh environments and guiding others through danger.

COMMUNITY: HEARTHBORNE
Being part of a hearthborne community means you were raised in small villages or tight-knit rural communities. Hearthborne communities are built around closeness, mutual support, and a shared way of life. Members grow up knowing their neighbors intimately and learning the value of helping one another through difficult times. These communities may be farming villages, crafting hamlets, or small fishing towns — what unites them is the deep sense of belonging and care for one's neighbors.
Community Feature - Close-Knit: Once per long rest, you can spend any number of Hope to give an ally the same number of Hope. This reflects the hearthborne tradition of selfless community support.

ANCESTRY: DAEMON
Daemons are beings touched by otherworldly energies, walking between mortal and supernatural realms. They carry an innate connection to forces beyond the material world — whether demonic, celestial, fey, or something stranger. Daemons often have unusual physical features that mark their supernatural heritage: unnatural eye colors, faintly glowing markings, small horns, or an aura that makes others uneasy. Despite their otherworldly nature, daemons are as varied in personality and motivation as any other ancestry.
Ancestry Feature - Otherworldly Presence: You can see in magical darkness. Once per long rest, you may sense the presence of supernatural creatures within far range. This innate supernatural awareness reflects the daemon's deep connection to forces beyond the mortal veil.

COMPLETE LIST OF DAGGERHEART COMMUNITIES
Daggerheart includes the following 13 communities that players can choose from during character creation. Each community represents the culture or environment a character grew up in and grants a unique community feature:
1. Duneborne - Desert and arid climate communities
2. Freeborne - Liberated communities that overthrew tyranny
3. Frostborne - Frozen tundra and glacial region communities
4. Hearthborne - Small villages and tight-knit rural communities
5. Highborne - High-society, wealthy, and prestigious communities
6. Loreborne - Academic and politically focused communities
7. Orderborne - Disciplined, faith-based, or militaristic communities
8. Ridgeborne - Mountain and cliff-dwelling communities
9. Seaborne - Coastal and seafaring communities
10. Slyborne - Criminal underworld and outlaw communities
11. Underborne - Subterranean and underground communities
12. Wanderborne - Nomadic and traveling communities
13. Wildborne - Deep forest and wilderness communities

COMPLETE LIST OF DAGGERHEART ANCESTRIES
Daggerheart includes the following ancestries that players can choose from during character creation. Each ancestry provides unique physical characteristics and an ancestry feature:
1. Clank - Mechanical beings of gears and magic
2. Daemon - Beings touched by otherworldly energies
3. Drakona - Dragonborn humanoids with draconic heritage
4. Dwarf - Sturdy folk of mountain and forge
5. Elf - Graceful beings with deep connections to magic
6. Faerie - Tiny fey creatures of mischief and magic
7. Faun - Half-human, half-goat nature folk
8. Firbolg - Gentle giants tied to nature
9. Fungril - Mushroom folk who thrive in darkness
10. Galapa - Turtle-like beings of wisdom and patience
11. Giant - Towering folk of immense strength
12. Goblin - Small, scrappy creatures of cunning
13. Halfling - Small folk known for luck and courage
14. Human - Versatile and adaptable
15. Infernis - Humanoids with demonic heritage from the Circles Below
16. Katari - Feline humanoids of grace and curiosity
17. Orc - Proud warriors with honor-bound cultures
18. Ribbet - Amphibious frog-folk
19. Simiah - Ape-like beings of strength and community
Players may also choose Mixed Ancestry to combine features from multiple ancestries.
